events.description: 5. TEXT ORDER entered by U.S. District Judge Sue E. Myerscough on 11/18/2026 Before the Court is Plaintiffs' Emergency Motion for Relief Before Certification (d/e 3 ). Due to possible time constraints as to election certification, the Court DIRECTS the Defendants to file an expedited Response on or before November 20, 2026. As service has not been effectuated nor appearances of counsel entered, the Court DIRECTS the Clerk's Office to send a copy of this Text Order forthwith by email to GeneralCounsel@elections.il.gov. (BMG) (Entered: 11/18/2026)
